bible_quanes.question: How does Mark's Gospel begin?
bible_quanes.answer: "The beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God"

bible_quanes.question: Where was Jesus from when He came to be baptized?
bible_quanes.answer: Nazareth of Galilee
bible_quanes.explanation: Baptized by John in the Jordan.

bible_quanes.question: What did Jesus say to Simon and Andrew?
bible_quanes.answer: "Follow Me, and I will make you become fishers of men"

bible_quanes.question: What did Jesus do early in the morning, a long while before daylight?
bible_quanes.answer: Went to a solitary place to pray

bible_quanes.question: What did John the Baptist wear?
bible_quanes.answer: Camel's hair with a girdle of a skin about his loins
bible_quanes.explanation: And ate locusts and wild honey.

bible_quanes.question: With whom was Jesus in the wilderness?
bible_quanes.answer: The wild beasts, and angels ministered to Him

bible_quanes.question: Who cried out in the synagogue at Capernaum?
bible_quanes.answer: A man with an unclean spirit
bible_quanes.explanation: "I know who You are, the Holy One of God!"

bible_quanes.question: How did Jesus respond to the leper?
bible_quanes.answer: Moved with compassion, He touched him and said "I will; be thou clean"

bible_quanes.question: Whom did James and John leave in the boat?
bible_quanes.answer: Their father Zebedee with the hired servants

bible_quanes.question: Why could Jesus no longer openly enter the city?
bible_quanes.answer: He went out, and began to publish it much, and to blaze abroad the matter

bible_quanes.question: How did the friends bring the paralytic to Jesus?
bible_quanes.answer: They uncovered the roof and let him down

bible_quanes.question: Whom did Jesus come to call?
bible_quanes.answer: Sinners to repentance

bible_quanes.question: What did Jesus say about the Sabbath?
bible_quanes.answer: The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath

bible_quanes.question: Whom did Jesus call at the tax office in Mark 2?
bible_quanes.answer: Levi the son of Alphaeus

bible_quanes.question: How many men carried the paralytic?
bible_quanes.answer: Four

bible_quanes.question: What did the scribes say when Jesus forgave sins?
bible_quanes.answer: "Who can forgive sins but God only?"

bible_quanes.question: Why do the friends of the bridegroom not fast?
bible_quanes.answer: While the bridegroom is with them

bible_quanes.question: What happens to new wine in old wineskins?
bible_quanes.answer: The new wine doth burst the bottles

bible_quanes.question: Which high priest is named in Mark 2:26?
bible_quanes.answer: Abiathar

bible_quanes.question: In which city was Jesus when the paralytic was let down?
bible_quanes.answer: Capernaum
bible_quanes.explanation: It was heard that He was in the house.

bible_quanes.question: How many apostles did Jesus appoint?
bible_quanes.answer: Twelve
bible_quanes.explanation: To be with Him and to preach.

bible_quanes.question: What happens to a house divided against itself?
bible_quanes.answer: It cannot stand

bible_quanes.question: Who is Jesus' brother, sister and mother according to Mark 3:35?
bible_quanes.answer: Whosoever shall do the will of God

bible_quanes.question: What did Jesus tell the man with the withered hand?
bible_quanes.answer: "Stretch forth thine hand"

bible_quanes.question: With whom did the Pharisees plot against Jesus?
bible_quanes.answer: The Herodians

bible_quanes.question: What did Jesus call James and John?
bible_quanes.answer: Boanerges, "Sons of Thunder"

bible_quanes.question: What did Jesus' own people say about Him?
bible_quanes.answer: "He is beside himself"
bible_quanes.explanation: They went to lay hold of Him.

bible_quanes.question: What sin never has forgiveness?
bible_quanes.answer: He that shall blaspheme against the Holy Ghost

bible_quanes.question: Which disciple is called "the Canaanite"?
bible_quanes.answer: Simon

bible_quanes.question: From where had the scribes come?
bible_quanes.answer: Jerusalem

bible_quanes.question: What parable did Jesus teach first in Mark 4?
bible_quanes.answer: The parable of the sower
bible_quanes.explanation: A sower went out to sow.

bible_quanes.question: What did Jesus say to the sea?
bible_quanes.answer: "Peace, be still!"

bible_quanes.question: Where is a lamp put?
bible_quanes.answer: On a candlestick

bible_quanes.question: To what is the kingdom compared in Mark 4:26?
bible_quanes.answer: As if a man should cast seed into the ground, and the seed should spring and grow up, he knoweth not how

bible_quanes.question: How much did the seed on good ground yield?
bible_quanes.answer: Some thirty, some sixty and some an hundred

bible_quanes.question: What does the earth yield, according to Mark 4:28?
bible_quanes.answer: First the blade, then the ear, after that the full corn in the ear

bible_quanes.question: Where was Jesus during the storm?
bible_quanes.answer: In the hinder part of the ship, asleep on a pillow

bible_quanes.question: What did the disciples ask after the storm?
bible_quanes.answer: "Who can this be, that even the wind and the sea obey Him!"

bible_quanes.question: What did Jesus say about the measure we use?
bible_quanes.answer: With what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you

bible_quanes.question: How did Jesus speak to the crowds?
bible_quanes.answer: Not without a parable
bible_quanes.explanation: He explained privately to the disciples.

bible_quanes.question: What was the name of the demons in the man at the tombs?
bible_quanes.answer: Legion

bible_quanes.question: What did Jesus say to the healed woman?
bible_quanes.answer: "Daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole"

bible_quanes.question: What did Jesus say to Jairus's daughter?
bible_quanes.answer: "Talitha cumi" ("Damsel, I say unto thee, arise")

bible_quanes.question: Who was Jairus?
bible_quanes.answer: One of the rulers of the synagogue

bible_quanes.question: About how many swine ran into the sea?
bible_quanes.answer: About two thousand

bible_quanes.question: Where did the healed man proclaim what Jesus had done?
bible_quanes.answer: In Decapolis

bible_quanes.question: What had happened to the woman after many physicians?
bible_quanes.answer: She grew worse

bible_quanes.question: How old was Jairus's daughter?
bible_quanes.answer: Twelve years

bible_quanes.question: To which country did Jesus go in Mark 5:1?
bible_quanes.answer: The country of the Gadarenes

bible_quanes.question: Which disciples did Jesus allow into Jairus's house?
bible_quanes.answer: Peter, James and John

bible_quanes.question: What occupation is Jesus called in Mark 6:3?
bible_quanes.answer: The carpenter

bible_quanes.question: How did Jesus send out the Twelve?
bible_quanes.answer: By two and two

bible_quanes.question: What did Jesus do before breaking the five loaves?
bible_quanes.answer: Looked up to heaven and blessed them
bible_quanes.explanation: Then gave them to the disciples.

bible_quanes.question: What did Jesus say to the frightened disciples on the sea?
bible_quanes.answer: "Be of good cheer! It is I; do not be afraid"

bible_quanes.question: What did Jesus tell the Twelve to take for their journey?
bible_quanes.answer: Only a staff

bible_quanes.question: With what did the disciples anoint the sick?
bible_quanes.answer: Oil

bible_quanes.question: Why was Jesus moved with compassion for the crowd?
bible_quanes.answer: They were as sheep not having a shepherd

bible_quanes.question: How did the people sit for the meal?
bible_quanes.answer: By companies upon the green grass
bible_quanes.explanation: In ranks of hundreds and fifties.

bible_quanes.question: Why could Jesus do no mighty work in Nazareth?
bible_quanes.answer: Because of their unbelief

bible_quanes.question: What did Herod promise the daughter of Herodias?
bible_quanes.answer: Whatsoever thou shalt ask of me, unto the half of my kingdom

bible_quanes.question: What did Jesus say about people who honour God with their lips?
bible_quanes.answer: Their heart is far from Him

bible_quanes.question: What did Jesus say to the deaf man?
bible_quanes.answer: "Ephphatha" ("Be opened")

bible_quanes.question: What does Jesus say defiles a man?
bible_quanes.answer: The things which come out of him

bible_quanes.question: What did the people say about Jesus?
bible_quanes.answer: "He has done all things well"

bible_quanes.question: What word did the Pharisees use to avoid helping parents?
bible_quanes.answer: Corban (a gift to God)

bible_quanes.question: What did Jesus say about meats in Mark 7:19?
bible_quanes.answer: Purging all meats

bible_quanes.question: What nationality was the woman who begged for her daughter?
bible_quanes.answer: A Greek, a Syrophenician by nation

bible_quanes.question: What did Jesus do to the deaf man?
bible_quanes.answer: Put his fingers into his ears, and he spit, and touched his tongue

bible_quanes.question: What comes from within the heart of men?
bible_quanes.answer: Evil thoughts, adulteries, fornications, murders

bible_quanes.question: Through which region did Jesus go to the Sea of Galilee?
bible_quanes.answer: Through the midst of Decapolis

bible_quanes.question: What did Peter answer when Jesus asked who He was?
bible_quanes.answer: "You are the Christ"

bible_quanes.question: What must anyone who desires to follow Jesus do?
bible_quanes.answer: Deny himself, take up his cross and follow Him

bible_quanes.question: What does it profit a man to gain the whole world?
bible_quanes.answer: "What shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?"

bible_quanes.question: How many loaves did Jesus have to feed the four thousand?
bible_quanes.answer: Seven
bible_quanes.explanation: He gave thanks and broke them.

bible_quanes.question: Of which leavens did Jesus warn?
bible_quanes.answer: The leaven of the Pharisees and the leaven of Herod

bible_quanes.question: Where did Jesus take the blind man at Bethsaida?
bible_quanes.answer: Out of the town

bible_quanes.question: What did the blind man first see?
bible_quanes.answer: Men as trees, walking

bible_quanes.question: What did Jesus begin to teach about the Son of Man?
bible_quanes.answer: He must suffer, be rejected, be killed and rise after three days

bible_quanes.question: To which region did Jesus go after feeding the four thousand?
bible_quanes.answer: Dalmanutha

bible_quanes.question: Of whom will the Son of Man be ashamed?
bible_quanes.answer: Whosoever shall be ashamed of Him and of His words

bible_quanes.question: What did the voice from the cloud say at the transfiguration?
bible_quanes.answer: "This is My beloved Son. Hear Him!"

bible_quanes.question: What did Jesus say about believing?
bible_quanes.answer: All things are possible to him that believeth

bible_quanes.question: What did the father of the boy cry out?
bible_quanes.answer: "Lord, I believe; help my unbelief!"

bible_quanes.question: What did Jesus say about being first?
bible_quanes.answer: The same shall be last of all and servant of all

bible_quanes.question: What happened to Jesus' clothes at the transfiguration?
bible_quanes.answer: Shining, exceeding white as snow
bible_quanes.explanation: Whiter than any launderer could make.

bible_quanes.question: What did Jesus say about this kind of demon?
bible_quanes.answer: This kind can come forth by nothing, but by prayer and fasting

bible_quanes.question: What did Jesus take into His arms as an example?
bible_quanes.answer: A child
bible_quanes.explanation: Receiving a child is receiving Him.

bible_quanes.question: What is promised for giving a cup of water in Christ's name?
bible_quanes.answer: He shall not lose his reward

bible_quanes.question: What does Jesus say about hell in Mark 9?
bible_quanes.answer: Their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched

bible_quanes.question: What does Jesus tell the disciples to have in themselves?
bible_quanes.answer: Salt, and peace with one another

bible_quanes.question: What should man not separate?
bible_quanes.answer: What God has joined together

bible_quanes.question: How did Jesus react when the disciples rebuked those bringing children?
bible_quanes.answer: He was much displeased
bible_quanes.explanation: "Let the little children come to Me."

bible_quanes.question: Why did the Son of Man come, according to Mark 10:45?
bible_quanes.answer: Not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many

bible_quanes.question: What did Jesus say to Bartimaeus?
bible_quanes.answer: "Go thy way; thy faith hath made thee whole"

bible_quanes.question: What did the rich man ask Jesus?
bible_quanes.answer: "Good Master, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?"

bible_quanes.question: How did Jesus feel toward the rich man?
bible_quanes.answer: He loved him

bible_quanes.question: Who asked to sit at Jesus' right and left?
bible_quanes.answer: James and John

bible_quanes.question: Where did Jesus meet blind Bartimaeus?
bible_quanes.answer: Jericho

bible_quanes.question: What does the name Bartimaeus mean?
bible_quanes.answer: Son of Timaeus
bible_quanes.explanation: He sat by the road begging.

bible_quanes.question: What did Bartimaeus throw aside when called?
bible_quanes.answer: His garment

bible_quanes.question: What did the crowds cry as Jesus entered Jerusalem?
bible_quanes.answer: "Hosanna; Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord"

bible_quanes.question: What did Jesus say God's house should be called?
bible_quanes.answer: A house of prayer for all nations

bible_quanes.question: What did Jesus tell the disciples to have?
bible_quanes.answer: Faith in God

bible_quanes.question: What should we do when we stand praying?
bible_quanes.answer: Forgive, if we have ought against any

bible_quanes.question: What kind of animal did Jesus ride into Jerusalem?
bible_quanes.answer: A colt tied, whereon never man sat

bible_quanes.question: Why did the fig tree have no fruit?
bible_quanes.answer: The time of figs was not yet

bible_quanes.question: Who noticed the fig tree had withered?
bible_quanes.answer: Peter

bible_quanes.question: What did the chief priests ask Jesus?
bible_quanes.answer: "By what authority doest thou these things?"

bible_quanes.question: What did Jesus do when He first entered the temple?
bible_quanes.answer: Looked round about upon all things
bible_quanes.explanation: Then went to Bethany since it was late.

bible_quanes.question: What question did Jesus ask about John's baptism?
bible_quanes.answer: Was it from heaven or from men?

bible_quanes.question: What did Jesus say about rendering to Caesar?
bible_quanes.answer: Render to Caesar the things that are Caesar's, and to God the things that are God's

bible_quanes.question: What is the first commandment of all?
bible_quanes.answer: Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, soul, mind and strength

bible_quanes.question: What did the poor widow put into the treasury?
bible_quanes.answer: Two mites

bible_quanes.question: What did Jesus say about the widow's gift?
bible_quanes.answer: This poor widow hath cast more in than all they

bible_quanes.question: What parable begins Mark 12?
bible_quanes.answer: A certain man planted a vineyard and let it out to husbandmen

bible_quanes.question: From which passage did Jesus prove the resurrection?
bible_quanes.answer: How in the bush God spake unto Moses

bible_quanes.question: What did Jesus tell the wise scribe?
bible_quanes.answer: "You are not far from the kingdom of God"

bible_quanes.question: What do the scribes love?
bible_quanes.answer: Long clothing, salutations in the marketplaces and the chief seats

bible_quanes.question: What did the rejected stone become, in Mark 12:10?
bible_quanes.answer: The head of the corner

bible_quanes.question: What are two mites equal to?
bible_quanes.answer: A farthing

bible_quanes.question: What did Jesus say about the temple stones?
bible_quanes.answer: Not one stone shall be left upon another

bible_quanes.question: What will not pass away, according to Mark 13:31?
bible_quanes.answer: My words

bible_quanes.question: What does Jesus command at the end of Mark 13?
bible_quanes.answer: Take heed, watch and pray

bible_quanes.question: What must first be preached to all nations?
bible_quanes.answer: The gospel

bible_quanes.question: Which disciples asked Jesus privately on the Mount of Olives?
bible_quanes.answer: Peter, James, John and Andrew

bible_quanes.question: What are the beginnings of sorrows?
bible_quanes.answer: Nation shall rise against nation, earthquakes, famines and troubles

bible_quanes.question: Who will be saved?
bible_quanes.answer: He that shall endure unto the end

bible_quanes.question: How will the Son of Man come?
bible_quanes.answer: In the clouds with great power and glory

bible_quanes.question: What does the fig tree's tender branch tell us?
bible_quanes.answer: Summer is near

bible_quanes.question: At which times might the master of the house come?
bible_quanes.answer: At even, or at midnight, or at the cockcrowing, or in the morning

bible_quanes.question: What did Jesus say as He broke the bread?
bible_quanes.answer: "Take, eat; this is My body"

bible_quanes.question: How did Jesus address God in Gethsemane?
bible_quanes.answer: "Abba, Father"
bible_quanes.explanation: All things are possible for You.

bible_quanes.question: What did all the disciples do when Jesus was arrested?
bible_quanes.answer: Forsook Him and fled

bible_quanes.question: What did Peter do after the rooster crowed twice?
bible_quanes.answer: He wept

bible_quanes.question: What did the woman pour on Jesus' head?
bible_quanes.answer: Ointment of spikenard very precious

bible_quanes.question: For how much could the oil have been sold?
bible_quanes.answer: More than three hundred pence

bible_quanes.question: How many times did Jesus say the rooster would crow?
bible_quanes.answer: Twice
bible_quanes.explanation: Before Peter denied Him three times.

bible_quanes.question: Who fled naked when Jesus was arrested?
bible_quanes.answer: A certain young man

bible_quanes.question: What did Jesus say about the spirit and the flesh?
bible_quanes.answer: The spirit truly is ready, but the flesh is weak

bible_quanes.question: What did Jesus answer when the high priest asked if He was the Christ?
bible_quanes.answer: "I am"
bible_quanes.explanation: You will see the Son of Man.

bible_quanes.question: Whom did Pilate release to the crowd?
bible_quanes.answer: Barabbas
bible_quanes.explanation: He delivered Jesus to be crucified.

bible_quanes.question: What did the soldiers put on Jesus' head?
bible_quanes.answer: A crown of thorns

bible_quanes.question: What did the centurion say when Jesus died?
bible_quanes.answer: "Truly this Man was the Son of God!"

bible_quanes.question: Where was Jesus laid?
bible_quanes.answer: In a sepulchre which was hewn out of a rock
bible_quanes.explanation: A stone was rolled against the door.

bible_quanes.question: Whose father was Simon of Cyrene?
bible_quanes.answer: Alexander and Rufus

bible_quanes.question: At what hour was Jesus crucified?
bible_quanes.answer: The third hour

bible_quanes.question: What was the inscription of His accusation?
bible_quanes.answer: THE KING OF THE JEWS

bible_quanes.question: What did Jesus cry at the ninth hour in Aramaic?
bible_quanes.answer: "Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani?"
bible_quanes.explanation: My God, why have You forsaken Me?

bible_quanes.question: Which women watched from afar?
bible_quanes.answer: Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James the Less and Joses, and Salome

bible_quanes.question: How is Joseph of Arimathaea described?
bible_quanes.answer: An honourable counsellor, which also waited for the kingdom of God

bible_quanes.question: What did the young man at the tomb say?
bible_quanes.answer: "He is risen! He is not here"
bible_quanes.explanation: See the place where they laid Him.

bible_quanes.question: What did Jesus command the disciples in Mark 16:15?
bible_quanes.answer: "Go into all the world and preach the gospel to every creature"

bible_quanes.question: What happened to Jesus after He spoke to them?
bible_quanes.answer: He was received up into heaven and sat at the right hand of God

bible_quanes.question: To whom did Jesus appear first?
bible_quanes.answer: Mary Magdalene
bible_quanes.explanation: From whom He cast out seven demons.

bible_quanes.question: What did the women bring to the tomb?
bible_quanes.answer: Spices

bible_quanes.question: What were the women worried about?
bible_quanes.answer: "Who shall roll us away the stone from the door of the sepulchre?"

bible_quanes.question: Whom did the angel specially name to be told?
bible_quanes.answer: Peter

bible_quanes.question: How did the women react?
bible_quanes.answer: They fled; for they trembled and were amazed: neither said they any thing to any man

bible_quanes.question: What signs will follow those who believe?
bible_quanes.answer: They shall cast out devils, speak with new tongues, take up serpents, lay hands on the sick

bible_quanes.question: To whom did Jesus appear first after He was risen, according to Mark 16:9?
bible_quanes.answer: Mary Magdalene
bible_quanes.explanation: After His resurrection, Jesus appeared first to Mary Magdalene.
